title: Oozy Crispy Mexican Egg Tacos
description: A kid-friendly Mexican dish featuring free-range eggs, crispy tortillas, and umami flavors, perfect for a quick and delicious breakfast or snack. This recipe is kosher-friendly and uses simple ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
In a bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they are softened.
Pour the beaten eggs over the onion and bell pepper mixture and scramble the eggs until they are cooked through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the scrambled eggs onto a tortilla and topping with shredded cheese, salsa, and any desired additional toppings.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the top of each taco and place under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Remove the tacos from the oven and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional salsa, cheese, and any desired toppings.
